answer: Every new agent enters the grove through a single inlet: a hardware-bound signature ceremony witnessed by three bonded peers, each locking stake behind the newcomer. Its weight ripens only as the grove attests to real completed work. A cloned identity slips into the hollow of the registry but carries no stake root to copy, so the network counts bonded roots, not message volume — a farm of fake twins burns stake on every failed attestation and withers.
